name: eufy-sdk-docs
description: Host-facing docs site for the eufy SDK (VitePress). Self-contained — kept out of the SDK's dependency tree.

scripts.build: npm run docs:api && npm run guard:docs && vitepress build

//typescript: Pinned a major behind the SDK on purpose: TypeDoc reads the compiler through its JS API, and TypeScript 7 is the Go compiler with no JS API. Bumping it fails `npm ci` on TypeDoc's peer range. Dependabot is told to skip it — see .github/dependabot.yml.
